# Anne Shirley

## Appearance

Anne is a tall, slim girl with a pointed face, solemn gray eyes, and auburn hair that was previously bright red and briefly dyed green before being shingled into short curls. Her nose has seven tiny freckles across it that bother her, though her complexion features pale cheeks that flush pink with emotion. Her expressive face and luminous eyes change dynamically with her laughter and imaginative dreams.

_Sources: [v1 c9 P13](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0013), [v1 c13 P1](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0001), [v1 c27 P16](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0016), [v1 c27 P36](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0036), [v1 c28 P6](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0006), [v1 c29 P18](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0018), [v1 c37 P32](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0032), [v2 c1 P0](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0000), [v2 c16 P26](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0026), [v2 c19 P51](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0051), [v2 c23 P7](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0007), [v2 c27 P39](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0039), [v2 c27 P41](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0041)_

## Personality

Anne is an imaginative, passionate, and deeply romantic individual who frequently wanders into realms of vivid daydreaming. Highly ambitious and strong-willed, she strives to excel in her studies and work while upholding high moral ideals. She is fiercely loyal to her friends and intense in both her loves and her hold on grudges. Though prone to impulsive decisions and dramatic shifts between extreme joy and total despair, she possesses a natural charm and a genuine kindness that endears her to children and community members alike.

## History

Anne Shirley was born in Bolingbroke, Nova Scotia, but became an orphan in early infancy. She was raised in hard circumstances by Mrs. Thomas and Mrs. Hammond before being placed in an asylum. At eleven years old, she was brought to Avonlea when Matthew and Marilla Cuthbert of Green Gables decided to adopt a child. Though they had originally requested a boy, they chose to keep Anne, who quickly won their affection and formed a deep bond with Matthew as a kindred spirit. She swore eternal friendship with her neighbor Diana Barry and began attending Avonlea school. After schoolmate Gilbert Blythe teased her about her red hair, Anne harbored a intense grudge and engaged in a fierce academic rivalry with him for years. Over time, Anne's vivid imagination led her into various scrapes, including accidentally flavoring a cake with liniment, walking a roof ridgepole on a dare and breaking her ankle, and accidentally dying her hair green. She attended Queen's Academy, where she won the prestigious Avery Scholarship. Following Matthew's death and Marilla's failing eyesight, Anne chose to remain at Green Gables to care for Marilla rather than attend college immediately, taking up the position of schoolteacher at Avonlea School. As teacher, she helped form the Avonlea Village Improvement Society and took on a leadership role in community affairs alongside Gilbert, with whom she reconciled and became close friends.
